title: Origin of the nickname Muggsy and first drums
summary: He was torn between baseball, music and medicine and was nicknamed after John McGraw; he began as a school drummer leading a Christmas morning band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Uh, well, we think, where did you get the nickname? You told me once in Chicago, 25 years ago or so, but can you tell us again just how you got that name?

Well, I've, I was torn between three loves. Baseball, music, and medicine. And, uh, I was gonna make a training trip with the Giants when I was 14 years old. Yeah. And, uh, I was nicknamed Muggsy on account of Muggsy McGraw, then the manager of the New York Giants, because he was a spicy little guy. And he used to, if anything would go wrong, he'd run out on the field. Yeah. And I acted exactly like him. You know, they dubbed me Muggsy. That's also kind of my funny face.

Well, not funny, but it's a distinctive face. And, uh, it's good to be different. Everybody is a little different anyway, so we don't all look at that. Can you tell us something about your earliest music, when you started on music, and when it was, and what instrument?

Well, I started in grammar school as a drummer. And, uh, my mother bought me a set of drums, and I, oh, I was a leader of a band when I was around nine or ten years old until the Christmas morning, I had the only snare drum. And we'd tour the neighborhood about 5.30 in the morning, Christmas morning, and wake up everyone, and they'd have to give us some money, or we'd still keep on playing.
